title: The electromagnetic black project at the base
summary: Dan Sherman tells of The electromagnetic black project at the base, about early 1990s at Overseas base, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: the black project was a very interesting into itself.

plain: Dan Sherman, a former sergeant who says the National Security Agency, the US spy agency for communications, hired him to speak with aliens, tells podcast host Jesse Michels about a black project, meaning a secret programme hidden from public view. He says it ran at an overseas base in the early 1990s, involved electromagnetic work, and was very interesting in itself. He tells it as part of his account of the secret work he says he did.
